title: A Slow Fire
author: Gopikrishnan Kottoor
text:
Now and then, in our lives
there comes this desire
to be with the universe all alone
with birds, with trees,
with small things that move and breathe
not knowing that they are part,
of that heart, we with our intellect, call God— but to them,
that's nowhere, and nothing.
They know nothing of the bright colours
upon them, the venom they are gifted with, or the honey
they'll dip headlong into flowers for—
now and then this desire, to be the sea,
the moon and the stars,
The eloquence of the wind that
dresses the night rocks with its drapery,
this want to be by your side loving you
as though I never truly loved you before,
to lay you on me,
as jasmine upon dark hair
making love with all its fragrance
seminal in a fluid night,
some desires, they have no end,
though they clock the bend
and somewhere, where no none knows or cares,
Time in a vagabond move
Builds you its slow fire.
